teaser.en: The hard, shelf-like fungus on old tree trunks, named by the Digo but not counted as a mushroom.
teaser.sw: Kuvu ngumu yenye umbo la rafu kwenye vigogo vya miti mizee, iliyopewa jina na Wadigo lakini isiyohesabiwa kuwa uyoga.

summary.en: Dzogalele are Ganoderma bracket fungi, tough woody shelves that grow out of tree trunks and stumps. The Digo name them but do not class them as uoga, the true mushrooms.
summary.sw: Dzogalele ni kuvu-rafu za jenasi *Ganoderma*, rafu ngumu kama mbao zinazoota kutoka kwenye vigogo na visiki vya miti. Wadigo huzipa jina lakini hawaziweki katika kundi la uoga, uyoga halisi.

about.en: *Dzogalele* are bracket fungi. They grow out of living or dead tree trunks as hard, woody shelves or hoof shapes, with a ridged, brown to reddish top that can look varnished in some species, and a pale underside full of tiny pores. They grow larger year by year, and the pores release a fine brown spore dust that often coats the bark below.
about.sw: *Dzogalele* ni kuvu-rafu (*bracket fungi*). Huota kutoka kwenye vigogo vya miti hai au iliyokufa kama rafu ngumu kama mbao au maumbo ya kwato, zikiwa na sehemu ya juu yenye mikunjo, ya kahawia hadi nyekundu-kahawia, ambayo kwa spishi nyingine huonekana kama imepakwa varnishi, na upande wa chini uliofifia uliojaa vitundu vidogo sana. Hukua kubwa zaidi mwaka hadi mwaka, na vitundu hutoa vumbi laini la vijimbegu vya kahawia ambalo mara nyingi hufunika gome lililo chini yake.

where.en: They grow on trunks, stumps and roots of trees in forest, woodland and farmland, and can rot the wood of their host.
where.sw: Huota kwenye vigogo, visiki na mizizi ya miti msituni, katika misitu na mashambani, na zinaweza kuoza mbao za mti unaozibeba.

uses.en: No Digo use is recorded. In East Asia some *Ganoderma*, known as reishi or lingzhi, are prized in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Katika Asia Mashariki, baadhi ya *Ganoderma*, zinazojulikana kama *reishi* au *lingzhi*, huthaminiwa sana katika tiba asilia.

culture.en: Pakia found that bracket fungi like *Ganoderma*, puffballs and earth stars are not counted as true *uoga*, the fleshy mushrooms, and are not put in any other plant category.
culture.sw: Pakia aligundua kuwa kuvu-rafu kama *Ganoderma*, *puffballs* na kuvu-nyota hazihesabiwi kuwa *uoga* halisi, yaani uyoga wenye nyama, na wala haziwekwi katika kundi jingine lolote la mimea.

names.en: Pakia records *dzogalele*; its meaning is not explained. No Swahili name is recorded. In English they are bracket fungi or shelf fungi.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *dzogalele*; maana yake haielezwi. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *bracket fungi* au *shelf fungi*.

reason.en: another fungus not counted as uoga

reason.sw: mti wa msituni, mbebaji wa kuvu
